failure_modes: 1. Depositor numbering differs from reference; postMapped resolves it. (missed coverage)
2. Target-name metadata is family-level (RAS, RAF); it provides no usable HGNC key. (missed coverage)
3. Full-text search returns zero for genes that have score sets. (missed coverage)
4. Haplotypes: a VRS reader ignoring members drops them; a substring match on hgvs_pro misattributes combination scores to single variants.
5. Isoform mismatch: hgvs_pro and postMapped can reference different isoforms of the same gene. Sole source of a false-positive coverage call in this audit.
caveats: All inventoried score sets with a published mapping were retrieved.
Existence of an assay is not fitness for germline classification.
RUO calibration is not equivalent to calibrated.
Nothing here constitutes a variant classification. No score set involved carries a published calibration, so no failure mode here altered a classification - only coverage ascertainment.
